Bitter, installed by KOReader-first Nook.

Source: https://github.com/solmatas/BitterPro
Commit: de749c69b5ffdb4b109c10d8fc331c3ecc4e39c5 (fonts/variable/Bitter[wght].ttf and Bitter-Italic[wght].ttf, version 3.021)
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL.txt in this folder). Reserved Font Name:
"Bitter Pro" (not used here; these fonts are named "Bitter", as upstream's are).

These static fonts are modified versions: each is one named instance (Thin to Black,
upright and italic) of the variable fonts above, made with scripts/make-bitter-static.py
in the KOReader-first Nook repository, because KOReader uses only a variable font's
default instance (Thin, for Bitter). fontTools' instancer fixed the weight and updated
the names and style bits; the PostScript name and unique ID were set from each instance's
own PostScript name. Outlines are those of the variable fonts at each instance.
